parameters.formDescription:
Step 1 of 2 - identify the alert under review.
contain_requested creates an approval-required request; no containment action is executed (human approval required).

nodes.name: Form Trigger - Analyst Feedback
nodes.notes: n8n Form Trigger (required upstream of the 'Form - Feedback' page). Production form URL: /form/soc-analyst-feedback-form. Page 1 collects alert_id + analyst_email; page 2 (Form - Feedback) collects verdict + notes. typeVersion 2.1 + responseMode=responseNode is the supported n8n 1.85.0 combination when a Respond to Webhook node ends the form (v2.2 forbids it). contain_requested creates an approval-required request; no containment action is executed.

options.formDescription:
Step 2 of 2 - submit your verdict.
contain_requested creates an approval-required request; no containment action is executed (human approval required).

nodes.name: Form - Feedback
nodes.notes: Next Form Page (page 2 of 2). Valid because the Form Trigger node is upstream. Preserves the original feedback fields and the verdict allow-list dropdown (true_positive, false_positive, benign, escalate, acknowledged, resolved, contain_requested). contain_requested creates an approval-required request; no containment action is executed. No autonomous.

nodes.name: Validate Form & Verdict
nodes.notes: Form-branch validation: merges page 1 (alert_id, analyst_email) with page 2 (verdict, notes), enforces the verdict allow-list, rejects full_log, and normalizes the payload for the shared HTTP POST node. contain_requested creates an approval-required request; no containment action is executed. No secrets, no destructive, no autonomous.

nodes.name: Webhook - Analyst Feedback
nodes.notes: Machine-to-machine feedback entry (API clients with the shared token). Validates token, forwards to triage-api POST /feedback. NEVER wired to the Form page - n8n Form pages require a Form Trigger upstream. No autonomous containment - contain_requested creates an approval-required request; no containment action is executed.

nodes.name: Validate Token & Verdict
nodes.notes: Real token validation against $env secret (exact match, reject missing/wrong, never log). Validates verdict allow-list. contain_requested creates an approval-required request; no containment action is executed - no host isolation/user disable/containment. No destructive, no autonomous, no secrets.

nodes.name: HTTP - POST Feedback to API
nodes.notes: POST feedback to triage-api (shared by the form and webhook entries; the form submission reaches this node after 'Validate Form & Verdict'). method=POST + contentType=json are explicit: n8n httpRequest v4 defaults to GET which silently dropped the body (runtime fix). Token from env credential $env.N8N_WEBHOOK_TOKEN || $env.N8N_CALLBACK_TOKEN. Verdict allow-list enforced. contain_requested creates an approval-required request; no containment action is executed. No autonomous containment.

nodes.name: Switch - Contain Requested?
nodes.notes: Routing rule (Switch v3.2 filter format — the previous typeVersion 2 node carried IF-style parameters that Switch ignores, so no branch ever fired; runtime fix). Output 0 'approval_required': verdict contains contain_requested -> approval email ONLY. Fallback output 'recorded': every other verdict -> Respond. No containment action is executed - no host isolation, no user disable. Human approval required.

parameters.subject: ={{ '[SOC][CONTAINMENT REQUEST - APPROVAL REQUIRED] Alert ' + ($json.alert_id || $json.body && $json.body.alert_id || 'unknown') }}
parameters.text:
={{ 'Containment requested for alert ' + ($json.alert_id || 'unknown') + '

IMPORTANT: contain_requested creates an approval-required request; no containment action is executed. No host isolation, no user disable, no autonomous action. Human approval required via ticketing system.

Verdict: ' + $json.verdict + '
Notes: ' + ($json.notes || '') + '
Actor: ' + ($json.actor || '') }}

nodes.name: Email - Containment Approval Request
nodes.notes: Approval-required containment request. No containment action executed. Human approval only. No autonomous.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { "status": "feedback_received", "alert_id": $('HTTP - POST Feedback to API').first().json.alert_id, "verdict": $('HTTP - POST Feedback to API').first().json.verdict, "note": "contain_requested creates an approval-required request; no containment action is executed", "formSubmittedText": "Feedback recorded for alert " + ($('HTTP - POST Feedback to API').first().json.alert_id || 'unknown') + " (verdict: " + ($('HTTP - POST Feedback to API').first().json.verdict || 'n/a') + "). If you requested containment, an approval request was created - no containment action is executed without human approval." } }}

nodes.name: Respond - Feedback OK
nodes.notes: Closes BOTH entries: JSON body for webhook callers, formSubmittedText key renders the n8n Form completion screen for form submissions (n8n 1.85.0 form-frontend contract). Values are read from the HTTP POST response, which is executed on every path (the emailSend output is the SMTP info object, not the alert). Uses the responseBody parameter (the old responseData name fell back to the default body). contain_requested creates an approval-required request; no containment action is executed.

meta.description: Phase 2E feedback workflow FIXED for n8n 1.85.0: the analyst form is a real n8n Form workflow - Form Trigger (/form/soc-analyst-feedback-form, page 1: alert_id + analyst_email) -> Form - Feedback page (page 2: verdict allow-list dropdown + notes) -> Validate Form & Verdict -> POST /api/v1/alerts/{id}/feedback with the shared token. The machine webhook entry (POST /webhook/soc-analyst-feedback) keeps the Phase 2B token gate (exact match, reject missing/wrong, never log) and is no longer wired to the Form page. contain_requested creates an approval-required request; no containment action is executed (no host isolation, no user disable, no autonomous containment). Human approval only. No secrets, no full_log, no destructive.
